prompt: "A seamless Japanese mystic pattern inspired by traditional folklore. Haunting kitsune masks with glowing eyes, shadowy figures drifting through mist, and ethereal cherry blossom petals scattered in the wind create a mysterious atmosphere. The dark background enhances the supernatural feel, with bold red and blue accents adding depth and contrast. The pattern is intricately detailed, balanced, and seamlessly repeatable. High-resolution, ultra-detailed, traditional Japanese folklore aesthetic, dark fantasy style. --chaos 50 --ar 1:2 --stylize 750 --v 6.1
